name: Performance Reminder Daily
script:
# ============================================================ # Magick Performance - Daily Reminder Engine # Runs daily via scheduler. Two phases, both driven by # submitted Performance Settings documents: # Phase 1: KRA & Goal Setup vs submission_deadline # Phase 2: Performance Evaluation vs evaluation_deadline # Cadence : D-7, D-3, D-1, D-0, then daily while overdue (max 7 days) # Channels: in-app bell (Notification Log) + email (best effort) # Escalation: overdue items also notify the line manager # ============================================================ today = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate()) BEFORE = (7, 3, 1, 0) OVERDUE_MAX = 7 base = frappe.utils.get_url() def due_kind(deadline): if not deadline: return None, None d = frappe.utils.date_diff(frappe.utils.getdate(deadline), today) if d in BEFORE: return "due", d if -OVERDUE_MAX <= d < 0: return "overdue", d return None, d def phrase(kind, d): if kind == "overdue": return "OVERDUE by " + str(-d) + " day(s)" if d == 0: return "due TODAY" return "due in " + str(d) + " day(s)" def bell(user, subject, body, ref_dt, ref_dn): if not user or not frappe.db.exists("User", user): return # once per user+subject per day (idempotent if run twice) dup = frappe.db.exists("Notification Log", { "for_user": user, "subject": subject, "creation": (">=", str(today) + " 00:00:00"), }) if dup: return frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "Notification Log", "for_user": user, "type": "Alert", "subject": subject, "email_content": body, "document_type": ref_dt, "document_name": ref_dn, }).insert(ignore_permissions=True) def mail(user, subject, body): if not user: return try: frappe.sendmail(recipients=[user], subject=subject, content=body) except Exception: pass # no outgoing account configured - bell still delivered def send(user, subject, body, ref_dt, ref_dn): bell(user, subject, body, ref_dt, ref_dn) mail(user, subject, body) def body_html(greet_name, line1, link, link_label, deadline): return ( "

Hi " + (greet_name or "there") + ",

" + "

" + line1 + "

" + "

Deadline: " + frappe.utils.formatdate(deadline) + "

" + "

" + link_label + "

" + "

This is an automated reminder. " + "You will keep receiving it until the task is completed.

" ) for ps in frappe.get_all( "Performance Settings", filters={"docstatus": 1}, fields=["name", "cycle_year", "submission_deadline", "evaluation_deadline"], ): # ---------------- PHASE 1: KRA & Goal Setup ---------------- res = due_kind(ps.submission_deadline) kind = res[0] d = res[1] if kind: when = phrase(kind, d) # a) employee still drafting / was rejected for r in frappe.get_all( "KRA and Goal Setup", filters={"performance_settings": ps.name, "status": ["in", ["Draft", "Rejected"]]}, fields=["name", "employee_name", "employee_user", "line_manage_user", "status"], ): link = base + "/app/kra-and-goal-setup/" + r.name subj = "[Reminder] KRA & Goal Setup " + str(ps.cycle_year) + " - " + when extra = " (it was rejected - please revise and resubmit)" if r.status == "Rejected" else "" body = body_html( r.employee_name, "Your KRA & Goal Setup for cycle " + str(ps.cycle_year) + " is " + when + extra + ".", link, "Open my KRA & Goal Setup", ps.submission_deadline, ) send(r.employee_user, subj, body, "KRA and Goal Setup", r.name) if kind == "overdue": esubj = "[Escalation] " + (r.employee_name or r.name) + " - KRA & Goal Setup " + when ebody = body_html( None, "" + (r.employee_name or r.name) + " has not completed their KRA & Goal Setup for cycle " + str(ps.cycle_year) + " (" + when + ").", link, "Open the document", ps.submission_deadline, ) send(r.line_manage_user, esubj, ebody, "KRA and Goal Setup", r.name) # b) waiting on the manager for r in frappe.get_all( "KRA and Goal Setup", filters={"performance_settings": ps.name, "status": "Pending Manager Approval"}, fields=["name", "employee_name", "line_manage_user"], ): link = base + "/app/kra-and-goal-setup/" + r.name subj = "[Action needed] Approve KRA & Goal Setup of " + (r.employee_name or r.name) + " - " + when body = body_html( None, "The KRA & Goal Setup of " + (r.employee_name or r.name) + " (cycle " + str(ps.cycle_year) + ") is waiting for your approval and is " + when + ".", link, "Review & approve", ps.submission_deadline, ) send(r.line_manage_user, subj, body, "KRA and Goal Setup", r.name) # ---------------- PHASE 2: Performance Evaluation ---------------- res = due_kind(ps.evaluation_deadline) kind = res[0] d = res[1] if kind: when = phrase(kind, d) for k in frappe.get_all( "KRA and Goal Setup", filters={"performance_settings": ps.name, "status": "Approved"}, fields=["name", "employee", "employee_name", "employee_user", "line_manage_user"], ): pe = frappe.db.get_value( "Performance Evaluation", {"kra_and_goal_setup": k.name}, ["name", "status", "employee_user", "line_manager_user", "employee_name"], as_dict=True, ) if not pe: link = base + "/app/performance-evaluation/new?kra_and_goal_setup=" + k.name subj = "[Reminder] Performance Evaluation " + str(ps.cycle_year) + " - " + when body = body_html( k.employee_name, "You have not started your Performance Evaluation for cycle " + str(ps.cycle_year) + ". It is " + when + ".", link, "Start my Performance Evaluation", ps.evaluation_deadline, ) send(k.employee_user, subj, body, "KRA and Goal Setup", k.name) if kind == "overdue": send(k.line_manage_user, "[Escalation] " + (k.employee_name or k.name) + " - Performance Evaluation " + when, body, "KRA and Goal Setup", k.name) elif pe.status in ("Draft", "Revision Requested"): link = base + "/app/performance-evaluation/" + pe.name subj = "[Reminder] Performance Evaluation " + str(ps.cycle_year) + " - " + when extra = " (revision was requested - please update and resubmit)" if pe.status == "Revision Requested" else "" body = body_html( pe.employee_name, "Your Performance Evaluation for cycle " + str(ps.cycle_year) + " is " + when + extra + ".", link, "Open my Performance Evaluation", ps.evaluation_deadline, ) send(pe.employee_user, subj, body, "Performance Evaluation", pe.name) if kind == "overdue": send(pe.line_manager_user, "[Escalation] " + (pe.employee_name or pe.name) + " - Performance Evaluation " + when, body, "Performance Evaluation", pe.name) elif pe.status == "Submitted by Employee": link = base + "/app/performance-evaluation/" + pe.name subj = "[Action needed] Review evaluation of " + (pe.employee_name or pe.name) + " - " + when body = body_html( None, "The Performance Evaluation of " + (pe.employee_name or pe.name) + " (cycle " + str(ps.cycle_year) + ") is waiting for your review and is " + when + ".", link, "Review now", ps.evaluation_deadline, ) send(pe.line_manager_user, subj, body, "Performance Evaluation", pe.name) frappe.db.commit()

# ============================================================ # SERVER SCRIPT — Performance Settings # Script Type : API # API Method : blast_email_performance # ============================================================ # Only HR may trigger the cycle e-mail blast (added 2026-09-17) _roles = {r[0] for r in frappe.db.sql( "select role from `tabHas Role` where parent=%s and parenttype='User'", (frappe.session.user,))} if not (_roles & {"HR Manager", "System Manager"}): frappe.throw("Only HR Manager or System Manager may send the performance cycle e-mail.", frappe.PermissionError) docname = frappe.form_dict.get('docname') if not docname: frappe.throw("Document name not found.") # Flag ini men-skip semua validasi custom (termasuk pengecekan weightage) # yang ada di hooks.py atau controller Python custom app doc = frappe.get_doc("Performance Settings", docname) doc.flags.ignore_validate = True doc.flags.ignore_mandatory = True doc.flags.ignore_validate_update_after_submit = True # sender intentionally NOT set - frappe.sendmail falls back to the site's # default outgoing Email Account. Do not hardcode a sender here. # (was: pengirim_email = "" - removed 2026-09-11) count = 0 failed = [] skipped_duplicate = [] if not doc.appraisees: frappe.throw("No employees (appraisees) found in this document.") base_url = frappe.utils.get_url() deadline = frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.submission_deadline) if doc.submission_deadline else "-" for d in doc.appraisees: try: employee_doc = frappe.get_doc("Employee", d.employee) recipient = ( employee_doc.get("user_id") or employee_doc.get("prefered_email") or employee_doc.get("company_email") or employee_doc.get("personal_email") ) if not recipient: failed.append( f"{d.employee_name} — no email found. " f"user_id='{employee_doc.get('user_id')}' | " f"prefered_email='{employee_doc.get('prefered_email')}' | " f"company_email='{employee_doc.get('company_email')}' | " f"personal_email='{employee_doc.get('personal_email')}'" ) continue # Cek duplikasi KRA and Goal Setup existing_kra = frappe.db.get_value( "KRA and Goal Setup", { "employee" : d.employee, "performance_settings": docname, }, "name" ) if existing_kra: kra_name = existing_kra skipped_duplicate.append(d.employee_name) else: kra_doc = frappe.new_doc("KRA and Goal Setup") kra_doc.employee = employee_doc.name kra_doc.employee_name = employee_doc.employee_name kra_doc.company = employee_doc.company kra_doc.performance_settings = docname kra_doc.cycle_year = doc.cycle_year kra_doc.status = "Draft" # notifications send to these User fields kra_doc.employee_user = employee_doc.get("user_id") if employee_doc.reports_to: kra_doc.reports_to = employee_doc.reports_to kra_doc.line_manager_name = frappe.db.get_value( "Employee", employee_doc.reports_to, "employee_name" ) kra_doc.line_manage_user = frappe.db.get_value( "Employee", employee_doc.reports_to, "user_id" ) kra_doc.flags.ignore_validate = True kra_doc.flags.ignore_mandatory = True kra_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True) kra_name = kra_doc.name kra_link = f"{base_url}/app/kra-and-goal-setup/{kra_name}" subject = f"[ACTION REQUIRED] Performance Evaluation Cycle {doc.cycle_year} is Now Open" message = f"""

Performance Cycle {doc.cycle_year}

{employee_doc.company}

Dear {employee_doc.employee_name},

The performance evaluation cycle for {doc.cycle_year} has officially begun. Please complete your KRA & Goal Setup as soon as possible.

Submission Deadline

{deadline}

⚠️ Important: Complete your KRA & Goal Setup first and get Manager approval before proceeding to Performance Evaluation.

📋   Open My KRA & Goal Setup

Or copy this link:
{kra_link}

If you encounter any issues, contact HR or IT.
This is an automated message. Please do not reply.

""" frappe.sendmail( recipients = [recipient], subject = subject, content = message ) count += 1 except Exception as e: failed.append(f"{d.employee_name}: {str(e)}") # Summary summary_parts = [f"Successfully sent emails to {count} employees."] if skipped_duplicate: summary_parts.append(f"Skipped (KRA already existed): {', '.join(skipped_duplicate)}") if failed: summary_parts.append(f"Failed / No Email Found:
" + "
".join(failed)) frappe.msgprint("

".join(summary_parts)) frappe.response['message'] = summary_parts[0]
